section_1_cloze.passage:
Last spring, Clara and I teamed up for a school geology project studying unusual rock formations on Pine Hill. [41] with notebooks and basic tools, we set off eagerly, [42] that this adventure would teach us more than just about rocks.
The first two days went smoothly. We drew stone patterns and recorded colour variations. Clara's artistic abilities [43] well with my systematic data collection skills. However, on Wednesday morning, [44] struck. While climbing to our usual observation spot, I tripped, sending our measurement [45] rolling down the hillside. My heart sank as we watched our only compass(指南针) disappear into thick bushes.
"Without those tools..." I said, frustration choking my voice. "Wait," Clara interrupted, [46] the afternoon shadows stretching across the rocks. "Remember what Mr. Evans taught about using natural markers?" Her eyes lit up with a(n) [47].
We spent the afternoon [48]. Clara tracked shadow lengths while I compared rock layers. When shadows proved [49], we used fern(蕨类植物) growth patterns as directional guides. Sometimes we argued about methods, but [50] our approaches came together like building blocks. By Friday, we'd created an [51] mapping system using nature's clues.
Our final presentation surprised everyone. The teachers [52] our creative method, but the real reward was discovering how different ideas combined to create [53].
That evening, Clara showed me her project journal. Beside rock sketches, she'd written: "Stones survive storms through [54]. So do good teams." I smiled, realizing our rocky challenge had taught us a valuable lesson: the strongest [55] doesn't lie in mountains, but in teamwork.

questions.explanation: 根据空格后的 'with notebooks and basic tools' 可知，作者和Clara带着笔记本和基本工具出发，'be armed with' 意为'装备着、配备着'，符合语境。易错点：学生可能不熟悉 arm 作动词表示'武装、配备'的用法。
questions.supplement:
A(Armed)：语境句：Armed with enough knowledge, the students are ready for the final exam. 固定搭配：be armed with, heavily armed
B(Burdened)：语境句：Burdened with heavy debts, the company finally went bankrupt. 固定搭配：be burdened with, bear a burden
C(Linked)：语境句：His sudden success is closely linked to his hard work over the years. 固定搭配：be linked to/with, closely linked
D(Rewarded)：语境句：The volunteers were rewarded with smiles from the children they helped. 固定搭配：reward sb. with sth., well rewarded

questions.explanation: 句意：我们满怀期待地出发了，却‘没有意识到’(unaware) 这次冒险教给我们的将不仅仅是关于岩石的知识。此处表示当时的一种未知的状态，选项C最符合逻辑。易错点：D选项 worried 不符合前文 'eagerly' 的积极情感基调。
questions.supplement:
A(proud)：语境句：She was extremely proud of her son's achievements in the competition. 固定搭配：be proud of, take pride in
B(doubtful)：语境句：It is doubtful whether the weather will be fine enough for the picnic. 固定搭配：be doubtful about, remain doubtful
C(unaware)：语境句：He was completely unaware of the danger hiding in the dark. 固定搭配：be unaware of, completely unaware
D(worried)：语境句：Parents are often worried about their children's safety on the internet. 固定搭配：be worried about, deeply worried

questions.explanation: 前文提到画石头图案和记录颜色，这是Clara的艺术能力；作者擅长系统的数据收集。两者完美‘互补/平衡’(balanced well with)。易错点：可能误选 A 或 D，但此处强调两人合作的优势互补。
questions.supplement:
A(developed)：语境句：The country has developed rapidly over the past few decades. 固定搭配：develop into, fully developed
B(balanced)：语境句：The sweet flavor is perfectly balanced with a touch of sourness. 固定搭配：balance with, strike a balance
C(replaced)：语境句：The old computers in our classroom will be replaced by new ones soon. 固定搭配：replace A with B, be replaced by
D(competed)：语境句：Several tech companies competed fiercely for the leading position in the market. 固定搭配：compete with/against, compete for

questions.explanation: 下文讲述作者被绊倒并丢失了唯一的指南针，这对他们的测量任务来说是一场'灾难'。'disaster struck'（灾难降临）是固定表达。易错点：可能错选 A(conflict)，但丢失物品并非人际冲突。
questions.supplement:
A(conflict)：语境句：We should try to resolve the conflict through peaceful communication. 固定搭配：in conflict with, resolve a conflict
B(disaster)：语境句：When natural disaster struck, people from all over the country offered help. 固定搭配：disaster strikes, natural disaster
C(chance)：语境句：You shouldn't miss the chance to study abroad and broaden your horizons. 固定搭配：take a chance, by chance
D(inspiration)：语境句：The beautiful scenery of the lake provided inspiration for his poetry. 固定搭配：draw inspiration from, a flash of inspiration

questions.explanation: 根据后一句 'our only compass' (我们唯一的指南针) 可知，滚下山坡的是测量'工具'(tools)。前文也提到了 'basic tools'，属于原词复现。易错点：脱离上下文语境盲目猜测。
questions.supplement:
A(ropes)：语境句：They used strong ropes to secure the tent against the heavy wind. 固定搭配：learn the ropes, tie a rope
B(books)：语境句：He buried himself in books, preparing for the upcoming entrance exam. 固定搭配：hit the books, book in advance
C(notes)：语境句：The student took detailed notes during the professor's lecture. 固定搭配：take notes, compare notes
D(tools)：语境句：Language is one of the most important tools for human communication. 固定搭配：basic tools, powerful tool

questions.explanation: Clara打断了作者的话，并'指着'(pointing at) 延伸在岩石上的下午的阴影。此处表示动作，引起同伴的注意。易错点：B选项 marking down 意为记下，不符合此处‘引人注意自然现象’的动作。
questions.supplement:
A(pointing at)：语境句：The teacher was pointing at the map while explaining the geography of Asia. 固定搭配：point at, point out
B(marking down)：语境句：The store is marking down all winter coats for the spring sale. 固定搭配：mark down prices, mark it down
C(running after)：语境句：The police officer was seen running after the thief down the street. 固定搭配：run after a dream, run after somebody
D(blocking out)：语境句：She wore sunglasses, trying to block out the harsh sunlight. 固定搭配：block out the sun, block out memories

questions.explanation: Clara想起了老师教过的使用自然标记的方法，所以她的眼睛里闪烁着'主意'(idea)的光芒。'eyes lit up with an idea' 是常见搭配。易错点：误选 B(surprise)，虽然有意外之感，但此处核心在于她想到了解决问题的方法。
questions.supplement:
A(idea)：语境句：An innovative idea suddenly hit him while he was taking a walk. 固定搭配：come up with an idea, have a good idea
B(surprise)：语境句：To my great surprise, he showed up at the party despite the heavy rain. 固定搭配：in surprise, to one's surprise
C(secret)：语境句：The old recipe has been kept as a family secret for generations. 固定搭配：keep a secret, in secret
D(promise)：语境句：He made a promise that he would never be late again. 固定搭配：make a promise, keep a promise

questions.explanation: 接下来的一下午，Clara追踪阴影，作者比较岩石，这说明他们在一起尝试、'实验'(experimenting)自然标记法是否可行。易错点：A(reflecting) 反思，不符合此处动手实践的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(reflecting)：语境句：After the failure, he spent a lot of time reflecting on his past mistakes. 固定搭配：reflect on, reflect reality
B(experimenting)：语境句：The scientists are experimenting with new methods to cure the disease. 固定搭配：experiment with, do an experiment
C(planning)：语境句：We are planning a trip to the mountains for the upcoming holiday. 固定搭配：plan ahead, make a plan
D(wandering)：语境句：He spent the whole afternoon wandering aimlessly around the city center. 固定搭配：wander around, mind wanders

questions.explanation: 根据句意，当阴影被证明是'不可靠的'(unreliable)时，我们使用了蕨类植物的生长模式作为方向指引。上下文体现了方法的更替。易错点：未能识别出前后从句的转折与让步逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(helpful)：语境句：The advice given by the senior students proved extremely helpful. 固定搭配：be helpful to, helpful advice
B(dangerous)：语境句：It is dangerous to swim in the river without adult supervision. 固定搭配：highly dangerous, dangerous situation
C(unreliable)：语境句：The bus schedule in this small town can be highly unreliable. 固定搭配：unreliable source, highly unreliable
D(interesting)：语境句：I found it interesting to explore the diverse cultures of different countries. 固定搭配：find sth interesting, look interesting

questions.explanation: 前面说有时会争论，转折词but后表示，'逐渐地'(gradually) 我们的方法像搭积木一样结合在了一起。体现了一个磨合的过程。易错点：A(suddenly) 突然地，不符合团队磨合并最终达成一致的客观规律。
questions.supplement:
A(suddenly)：语境句：The weather suddenly turned cold, catching everyone completely off guard. 固定搭配：all of a sudden, stop suddenly
B(occasionally)：语境句：He mainly eats vegetarian food but occasionally enjoys a steak. 固定搭配：work occasionally, visit occasionally
C(frequently)：语境句：The bus breaks down frequently, causing great inconvenience to passengers. 固定搭配：frequently asked questions, visit frequently
D(gradually)：语境句：Through continuous practice, her spoken English improved gradually. 固定搭配：gradually increase, fade gradually

questions.explanation: 因为失去了原本的测量工具，所以他们利用自然线索建立了一个'替代的'(alternative) 测绘系统。易错点：D(advanced) 先进的，自然法则测绘并不能算是最先进的，而是没有工具时的替代方案。
questions.supplement:
A(interactive)：语境句：The museum features interactive exhibits that engage children in learning. 固定搭配：interactive whiteboard, interactive process
B(imaginary)：语境句：As a child, he often played with his imaginary friends in the garden. 固定搭配：imaginary friend, imaginary world
C(alternative)：语境句：Solar power provides a clean alternative to traditional fossil fuels. 固定搭配：alternative energy, alternative to
D(advanced)：语境句：The hospital is equipped with advanced medical equipment to treat patients. 固定搭配：advanced technology, in advance

questions.explanation: 由前面的 'surprised everyone' 和后面的 'real reward' 可以推断，老师对他们这种有创意的方法给予了'表扬'(praised)。易错点：A(tested) 虽然合理，但缺乏后文所体现的积极的情感反馈。
questions.supplement:
A(tested)：语境句：All the new drugs must be strictly tested before they enter the market. 固定搭配：be tested for, scientifically tested
B(improved)：语境句：His writing skills have greatly improved since he started reading more. 固定搭配：be greatly improved, improve on
C(selected)：语境句：She was selected from hundreds of candidates to play the leading role. 固定搭配：be selected as, carefully selected
D(praised)：语境句：The firefighters were highly praised for their bravery during the rescue. 固定搭配：be highly praised, praise sb. for sth.

questions.explanation: 不同的想法结合在一起创造出了'解决方案'(solutions)，呼应前文他们失去工具后想方设法完成任务的过程。易错点：D选项 presentations 虽然前文提到了，但结合想法创造出的是解决问题的方案，而不仅是展示本身。
questions.supplement:
A(connections)：语境句：Building strong social connections is vital for a successful career. 固定搭配：make connections, a strong connection
B(stories)：语境句：My grandfather used to tell me fascinating bedtime stories. 固定搭配：tell stories, share stories
C(solutions)：语境句：We need to brainstorm together to figure out effective solutions. 固定搭配：find a solution, practical solutions
D(presentations)：语境句：The manager asked us to prepare presentations for the upcoming meeting. 固定搭配：give a presentation, oral presentation

questions.explanation: 句意：石头通过'团结/聚集在一起'(unity) 挺过风暴，优秀的团队也是如此。呼应全文团队合作(teamwork)的主题。易错点：脱离主旨，A、C、D均无法体现 teamwork 的核心思想。
questions.supplement:
A(luck)：语境句：With a bit of luck and hard work, you will eventually achieve your goals. 固定搭配：good luck, push one's luck
B(unity)：语境句：The president appealed for national unity in the face of the economic crisis. 固定搭配：in unity, national unity
C(silence)：语境句：The library was in complete silence as everyone was absorbed in reading. 固定搭配：in silence, break the silence
D(speed)：语境句：He drove at a high speed, completely ignoring the traffic rules. 固定搭配：at top speed, pick up speed

questions.explanation: 最后一句点题：最坚固的'基石'(foundation)不是在于山脉之中，而是在团队合作之中。foundation 既符合地质学(石头/山)的意象，也用来比喻团队成功的基石。易错点：对 foundation 引申义不熟悉。
questions.supplement:
A(foundation)：语境句：Mutual respect and trust are the solid foundation of any good relationship. 固定搭配：lay a foundation, solid foundation
B(argument)：语境句：They got into a heated argument over where to spend their summer vacation. 固定搭配：win an argument, heated argument
C(desire)：语境句：She has a strong desire to travel around the world and explore different cultures. 固定搭配：strong desire, a desire for
D(system)：语境句：The school implemented a new grading system to evaluate student performance. 固定搭配：education system, immune system

vocab_pack.definition_en: to join together as a team to work on something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，此处用一般过去时teamed up，表示过去的一次合作。
vocab_pack.example_en: We decided to team up for the science fair project.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们决定为科学展览项目合作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Clara and I teamed up for a school geology project

vocab_pack.definition_en: equipped or provided with something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语作状语，表示伴随状态，相当于being armed with。
vocab_pack.example_en: Armed with a map and a compass, they set out on the hike.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 带着地图和指南针，他们出发去远足。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Armed with notebooks and basic tools, we set off eagerly

vocab_pack.definition_en: to start a journey or begin moving
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，此处用一般过去时set off，与主语we搭配。
vocab_pack.example_en: They set off early in the morning to avoid traffic.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们一大早就出发以避免交通堵塞。
vocab_pack.from_passage: we set off eagerly

vocab_pack.definition_en: not realizing or knowing that something is true
vocab_pack.grammar_note: unaware为形容词，后跟that引导的从句，此处用一般现在时unaware，但实际在句中是形容词作伴随状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She was unaware that her phone had been stolen.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她没有意识到手机被偷了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: unaware that this adventure would teach us more than just about rocks

vocab_pack.definition_en: to happen without problems or difficulties
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词go作连系动词，后接副词smoothly，此处用一般过去时went。
vocab_pack.example_en: The interview seemed to go smoothly until the last question.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 面试直到最后一个问题之前似乎都很顺利。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The first two days went smoothly.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to complement or match harmoniously
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，此处用一般过去时balanced，后接副词well和介词with。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her logical thinking balances well with his creative ideas.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的逻辑思维与他的创意很好地互补。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Clara's artistic abilities balanced well with my systematic data collection skills.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a sudden, unexpected bad event happens
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定短语，此处用一般过去时struck，强调动作的突发性。
vocab_pack.example_en: Just as we were about to leave, disaster struck—the car wouldn't start.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 就在我们准备离开时，灾难降临了——车发动不了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: disaster struck.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause something to move or be in a particular state
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 使某物处于（持续运动）状态
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词send后接宾语和现在分词作宾补，此处用sending（现在分词）构成伴随状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: He kicked the ball, sending it flying over the fence.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他踢了球，球飞过了篱笆。
vocab_pack.from_passage: sending our measurement tools rolling down the hillside

vocab_pack.definition_en: someone feels a sudden loss of hope or sadness
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定表达，此处用一般过去时sank，主语My heart为第三人称单数。
vocab_pack.example_en: When I saw the grade, my heart sank.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 看到成绩时，我的心一沉。
vocab_pack.from_passage: My heart sank

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go out of sight by entering something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，此处为不带to的不定式，跟在watch后作宾语补足语（感官动词+宾语+动词原形）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The cat disappeared into the bushes before we could catch it.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那只猫在我们抓到它之前消失在了灌木丛中。
vocab_pack.from_passage: watched our only compass disappear into thick bushes

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make someone's speech difficult because of strong emotion
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词choke的现在分词短语choking my voice作伴随状语，表示说话时因情绪激动而哽咽。
vocab_pack.example_en: Tears streamed down her face, choking her voice.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 泪水顺着她的脸流下，声音哽咽。
vocab_pack.from_passage: frustration choking my voice

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stop someone from speaking or something from continuing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 此处用一般过去时interrupted，表示Clara打断了“我”的话。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please don't interrupt me while I'm explaining.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我解释时请不要打断我。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "Wait," Clara interrupted

vocab_pack.definition_en: to extend or cover an area from one side to another
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语stretching across作定语修饰shadows，表示正在进行的状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: A long bridge stretches across the river.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一座长桥横跨河流。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the afternoon shadows stretching across the rocks

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give lessons or information on a subject
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词teach后接介词about，此处用一般过去时taught。
vocab_pack.example_en: The professor taught us about the history of ancient Rome.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 教授给我们讲了古罗马的历史。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Remember what Mr. Evans taught about using natural markers?

vocab_pack.definition_en: someone's face shows excitement or happiness
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定表达，此处用一般过去时lit up，描述Clara突然有了主意时的表情变化。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her eyes lit up when she saw the birthday cake.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当她看到生日蛋糕时，眼睛亮了起来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Her eyes lit up with a(n) idea.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to use time in a particular activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词spend后接时间名词和动名词，此处用一般过去时spent。
vocab_pack.example_en: We spent the whole morning discussing the plan.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们花了整个上午讨论这个计划。
vocab_pack.from_passage: We spent the afternoon experimenting.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to follow the course or movement of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 此处用一般过去时tracked，表示Clara在实验中测量并记录影子长度。
vocab_pack.example_en: Scientists track the migration patterns of birds.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 科学家追踪鸟类的迁徙模式。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Clara tracked shadow lengths

vocab_pack.definition_en: to turn out to be a particular quality (link verb)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: prove作连系动词，后接形容词unreliable，此处用一般过去时proved。
vocab_pack.example_en: His method proved effective in the end.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的方法最终证明是有效的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: When shadows proved unreliable

vocab_pack.definition_en: to disagree or quarrel over a topic
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，此处用一般过去时argued about。
vocab_pack.example_en: They often argue about which TV show to watch.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们经常为看哪个电视节目而争论。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Sometimes we argued about methods

vocab_pack.definition_en: to combine or work in harmony
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，此处用一般过去时came together，比喻不同的方法像积木一样结合。
vocab_pack.example_en: All the elements of the design came together perfectly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 设计的所有元素完美地融合在一起。
vocab_pack.from_passage: our approaches came together like building blocks

vocab_pack.definition_en: basic components from which something is built
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，此处作介词like的宾语，表示比喻。
vocab_pack.example_en: Words are the building blocks of language.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 单词是语言的基本构件。
vocab_pack.from_passage: like building blocks

vocab_pack.definition_en: different from the usual or conventional; offering a choice
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 此处作定语修饰mapping system，表示“另外的、替代性的”。
vocab_pack.example_en: We need to find an alternative route to avoid traffic.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们需要找一条替代路线以避开交通拥堵。
vocab_pack.from_passage: an alternative mapping system

vocab_pack.definition_en: natural signs or indicators that provide information
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，名词所有格nature's修饰clues，意为“自然的线索”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Hikers often use nature's clues like moss on trees to find direction.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 徒步者常利用树上的苔藓等自然线索辨别方向。
vocab_pack.from_passage: using nature's clues

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to feel unexpected wonder or astonishment
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 此处用一般过去时surprised，表示最终展示结果超出了所有人的预期。
vocab_pack.example_en: The news surprised everyone in the room.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个消息让房间里每个人都吃了一惊。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Our final presentation surprised everyone.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to express approval or admiration
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 此处用一般过去时praised，主语teachers。
vocab_pack.example_en: The coach praised the team for their hard work.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 教练赞扬了球队的努力工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The teachers praised our creative method

vocab_pack.definition_en: the true benefit or gain from something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，此处作主语，be动词后接动名词短语表示真正的收获是什么。
vocab_pack.example_en: The real reward of volunteering is the sense of fulfillment.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 志愿服务的真正回报是成就感。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the real reward was discovering how different ideas combined to create solutions.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to join together in order to achieve a purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词combine后接不定式表示目的，此处用一般过去时combined。
vocab_pack.example_en: Various factors combined to cause the economic crisis.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 多种因素共同导致了经济危机。
vocab_pack.from_passage: how different ideas combined to create solutions

vocab_pack.definition_en: to let someone see or examine something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 此处用一般过去时showed，后接双宾语（me her project journal）。
vocab_pack.example_en: He showed me his collection of stamps.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他给我看了他的邮票收藏。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Clara showed me her project journal.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue to live or exist in spite of difficult conditions
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 此处用一般现在时（主语Stones复数，动词原形），表示普遍真理或格言式陈述。
vocab_pack.example_en: Only the strongest plants survive the harsh winter.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 只有最顽强的植物才能在严冬中存活。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Stones survive storms through unity.

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to say that the same thing applies to another person or thing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定倒装结构：So + 助动词 (do) + 主语，此处do代替前文动词survive，强调“好的团队也是如此”。
vocab_pack.example_en: I love classical music, and so does my brother.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我喜欢古典音乐，我弟弟也是。
vocab_pack.from_passage: So do good teams.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a difficult problem or task, often with obstacles
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 艰难的任务；颠簸的挑战
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词rocky修饰名词challenge，此处为名词短语作主语，喻指这次与岩石有关的困难经历。
vocab_pack.example_en: Starting a new business is a rocky challenge.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 创业是一项充满挑战的艰难任务。
vocab_pack.from_passage: our rocky challenge had taught us a valuable lesson

vocab_pack.definition_en: to provide important learning or insight through experience
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 上了一堂宝贵的课；使……获得重要教训
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词teach后接间接宾语us和直接宾语a valuable lesson，此处用过去完成时had taught。
vocab_pack.example_en: Failure taught him a valuable lesson about preparation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 失败给了他关于准备的宝贵教训。
vocab_pack.from_passage: our rocky challenge had taught us a valuable lesson

section_2_word_form.passage:
Once a little-known dish from China's northwest, Lanzhou beef noodle soup is now winning people's heart globally. A recent article describes [56] this surprisingly simple meal has become popular in [57] (city) like New York, London, and Sydney.
Appealing online photos and videos of the dish stimulate local people's appetite and arouse their curiosity, driving them to give [58] a try. Diners appreciate both its taste and the experience it offers. In a Manhattan eatery, cooks stretch dough(面团) into noodles right [59] customers' eyes. "It's like magic," said one diner. Diners are also amazed by the unique and [60] (impressive) chewy texture of Lanzhou noodles, which offers a distinct mouthfeel unlike any other.
The soup, [61] (cook) for hours with beef bones and spices, has a rich flavor. In Queens, a restaurant prepares a version [62] respects the dishes' cultural roots and combines 20 spices to produce a hearty soup. The owner even makes video calls to her grandparents in China for recipes. In Flushing, the owner of a noodle shop adapts the soup based on customer feedback, making it thicker and spicier [63] (suit) local preferences. As food expert C. Doyle notes, "There's no single 'correct' version — it keeps evolving."
From street food to a global star, Lanzhou beef noodle soup shows that sharing food [64] (bridge) cultural differences, with each bowl [65] (tell) a story of tradition, creativity, and the delight of flavor discovery.

questions.explanation: 考查宾语从句的引导词。describes 后面是一个宾语从句，从句 'this surprisingly simple meal has become popular' 结构完整，句意为描述了这道简单的美食是“如何”流行起来的，故填 how。易错点：误填 that，但从上下文语境看，文章是在讲述其走红的方式和过程，how 更贴切。
questions.supplement: 正确形(how)：语境句：The documentary details how the ancient pyramids were constructed. 固定搭配：know how to do, learn how。其它常见连词：what(作主/宾), that(不作成分只起连接作用)。

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。根据后面的列举 'New York, London, and Sydney' 可知，这里指的是多个城市，故需将 city 变为复数形式 cities。易错点：拼写错误，以辅音字母加y结尾的名词，变y为i加es。
questions.supplement: 正确形(cities)：语境句：Major cities around the world are facing serious traffic problems. 固定搭配：major cities, modern cities。原词city其它变形：citizen(n. 公民)。

questions.explanation: 考查代词。give it a try 是固定表达，意为“尝试一下”，其中的 it 代指上文提到的兰州牛肉面 (the dish)。易错点：填 them 误指代 people，但此处的动作是人们尝试这道菜。
questions.supplement: 正确形(it)：语境句：If you haven't tasted local street food, you really should give it a try. 固定搭配：give it a try, make it。其它变形：its(形容词性物主代词), itself(反身代词)。

questions.explanation: 考查介词。right before one's eyes 意为“就在某人眼前”，表示厨师当着顾客的面拉面。也可填入 in front of，但通常此处语法填空要求填一个词。易错点：误填 under 或 in，搭配不当。
questions.supplement: 正确形(before)：语境句：The magician made the coin disappear right before our eyes. 固定搭配：right before one's eyes, before long。常见相关介词：after, behind。

questions.explanation: 考查副词。所给词 impressive 需要修饰后面的形容词 chewy，因此必须变为副词形式 impressively，意为“令人印象深刻地有嚼劲”。易错点：直接保留形容词形式，忽略了修饰形容词需用副词的规则。
questions.supplement: 正确形(impressively)：语境句：The athlete performed impressively during the final match. 固定搭配：impressively high, perform impressively。原词impressive其它变形：impress(v.), impression(n.)。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。The soup 与 cook 之间是被动关系（汤被熬制），故使用过去分词 cooked 作后置定语，相当于 which is cooked...。易错点：误填 cooking，忽略了主被动关系。
questions.supplement: 正确形(cooked)：语境句：The meat, cooked slowly over a low fire, tastes extremely tender. 固定搭配：home-cooked, well-cooked。原词cook其它变形：cooker(n. 厨具), cooking(n./v-ing)。

questions.explanation: 考查定语从句。先行词是 a version，指物，且在定语从句中作 respects 的主语，因此填 that 或 which 均可。易错点：误填 what，what 不能引导定语从句。
questions.supplement: 正确形(that/which)：语境句：He bought a book that/which describes the history of artificial intelligence. 固定搭配：a version that, something that。关系词补充：who(指人), where(指地点)。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。店主让汤变得更浓更辣，目的是“为了”适应当地人的口味。用动词不定式 to suit 表示目的状语。易错点：误填 suiting 导致无法体现“目的”这一逻辑语义。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to suit)：语境句：The curriculum was specially designed to suit the needs of older learners. 固定搭配：to suit one's needs, suit oneself。原词suit其它变形：suitable(adj.), suitably(adv.)。

questions.explanation: 考查动词时态与主谓一致。that 引导的宾语从句中，主语是动名词短语 'sharing food'，谓语动词需用单数。文章陈述的是一个普遍真理/事实，故使用一般现在时 bridges。易错点：误填 bridge 或 bridged，忽略了单数主语或时态一致性。
questions.supplement: 正确形(bridges)：语境句：Music is a universal language that bridges different cultures and nations. 固定搭配：bridge the gap, bridge differences。原词bridge其它变形：bridging(现在分词), bridged(过去式)。

questions.explanation: 考查 with 复合结构。with + 宾语(each bowl) + 宾补，each bowl 与 tell 之间是主动关系（每一碗面都在诉说故事），故使用现在分词 telling。易错点：误填 told，弄错宾语和宾补间的主被动关系。
questions.supplement: 正确形(telling)：语境句：He sat on the chair with his eyes looking out of the window, telling a sad story. 固定搭配：tell a story, telling the truth。原词tell其它变形：told(过去式/过去分词), teller(n.)。

vocab_pack.definition_en: not widely known; obscure
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作定语修饰dish，为复合形容词，带有连字符。
vocab_pack.example_en: The little-known island attracts few tourists.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个鲜为人知的岛屿吸引的游客很少。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Once a little-known dish from China's northwest

vocab_pack.definition_en: to attract someone's affection or admiration
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中winning为现在分词，与is构成现在进行时is winning，people's heart为宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her kindness won everyone's heart.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的善良赢得了每个人的心。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Lanzhou beef noodle soup is now winning people's heart globally.

vocab_pack.definition_en: unexpectedly basic or easy
vocab_pack.grammar_note: surprisingly为副词修饰形容词simple，作定语修饰meal。
vocab_pack.example_en: The solution was surprisingly simple.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 解决方案出奇地简单。
vocab_pack.from_passage: this surprisingly simple meal

vocab_pack.definition_en: to gain popularity within a certain place or context
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中has become popular in为现在完成时，become为过去分词，与has构成完成时。
vocab_pack.example_en: The song became popular in many countries.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这首歌在许多国家变得流行。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has become popular in cities like New York

vocab_pack.definition_en: attractive or interesting
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作定语修饰photos and videos，为形容词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The appealing advertisement caught everyone's attention.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那则吸引人的广告抓住了所有人的注意力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Appealing online photos and videos

vocab_pack.definition_en: to increase one's desire to eat
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中stimulate为一般现在时谓语动词，主语为复数，用原形；local people's为定语修饰appetite。
vocab_pack.example_en: The smell of food stimulates my appetite.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 食物的香味刺激我的食欲。
vocab_pack.from_passage: stimulate local people's appetite

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make someone interested and want to know more
vocab_pack.grammar_note: arouse与stimulate并列，同为一般现在时谓语；their为所有格修饰curiosity。
vocab_pack.example_en: Mysterious stories always arouse my curiosity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 神秘的故事总能引起我的好奇心。
vocab_pack.from_passage: arouse their curiosity

vocab_pack.definition_en: attempt to do or experience something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中give it a try为不定式短语，作driving them to的宾语补足语，give用原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Why don't you give it a try? It's fun!
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你为什么不试试呢？很好玩的！
vocab_pack.from_passage: driving them to give it a try

vocab_pack.definition_en: to recognize the value or quality of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中appreciate为一般现在时谓语动词，主语Diners为复数，用原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: I appreciate your help very much.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我非常感激你的帮助。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Diners appreciate both its taste

vocab_pack.definition_en: to pull and extend dough to form noodles
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中stretch为一般现在时谓语，主语cooks为复数，用原形；dough为宾语；into noodles为结果状语。括号内为中文注释。
vocab_pack.example_en: The chef expertly stretches dough into noodles.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 厨师熟练地将面团拉成面条。
vocab_pack.from_passage: cooks stretch dough(面团) into noodles right before customers' eyes

vocab_pack.definition_en: in plain view, directly in front of someone
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 就在眼前；当着某人的面
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中right before customers' eyes作状语，表示动作发生的位置；customers'为所有格。
vocab_pack.example_en: The magic trick happened right before our eyes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 魔术就在我们眼前发生了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: right before customers' eyes

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be very surprised or impressed by something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中are amazed by为被动语态，amazed为过去分词，by引出动作执行者。
vocab_pack.example_en: Everyone was amazed by the breathtaking view.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每个人都被那壮丽的景色惊呆了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Diners are also amazed by the unique and impressively chewy texture

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a way that makes a strong positive impression
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中impressively为副词，修饰形容词chewy，表示程度。
vocab_pack.example_en: She performed impressively in the competition.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在比赛中表现出色，令人印象深刻。
vocab_pack.from_passage: unique and impressively chewy texture

vocab_pack.definition_en: a food's quality of being firm and needing to be chewed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中chewy texture为名词短语，作amazed by的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bread has a nice chewy texture.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这面包有很好的嚼劲。
vocab_pack.from_passage: chewy texture of Lanzhou noodles

vocab_pack.definition_en: a unique sensation in the mouth when eating or drinking
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中distinct mouthfeel为名词短语，作offer的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: This wine has a distinct mouthfeel of berries.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这款酒有独特的浆果口感。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which offers a distinct mouthfeel unlike any other

vocab_pack.definition_en: different from everything else
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 与任何其他不同；独一无二
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中unlike any other作状语，修饰offers，表示比较。
vocab_pack.example_en: His style is unlike any other artist's.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的风格与其他任何艺术家都不同。
vocab_pack.from_passage: unlike any other

vocab_pack.definition_en: to prepare food by heating it for a long time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中cooked为过去分词，作定语修饰The soup，表示被动完成；for hours表示持续时间。
vocab_pack.example_en: We cook the soup for hours to develop flavor.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们煮汤几个小时以入味。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The soup, cooked for hours with beef bones and spices

vocab_pack.definition_en: to possess a strong and pleasant taste
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中has为一般现在时，主语The soup为第三人称单数，故用has。
vocab_pack.example_en: The coffee has a rich flavor.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这咖啡有浓郁的风味。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has a rich flavor

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make a particular form or variant of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中prepares为一般现在时，主语a restaurant为第三人称单数，用prepares。
vocab_pack.example_en: Our company prepares a version of the software for beginners.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们公司为初学者准备了一个版本的软件。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a restaurant prepares a version that/which respects the dishes' cultural roots

vocab_pack.definition_en: to honor and maintain the original cultural traditions
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中respects为定语从句中谓语，先行词version为单数，故用respects；the dishes'为所有格。
vocab_pack.example_en: We must respect the cultural roots of each dish.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们必须尊重每道菜的文化根源。
vocab_pack.from_passage: version that/which respects the dishes' cultural roots

vocab_pack.definition_en: to mix together various spices
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中combines与prepares并列，为一般现在时，主语a restaurant（隐含）为第三人称单数，用combines。
vocab_pack.example_en: The recipe combines spices from different regions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个食谱混合了不同地区的香料。
vocab_pack.from_passage: combines 20 spices to produce a hearty soup

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make a substantial and satisfying soup
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中produce为不定式，表示目的，与to搭配。
vocab_pack.example_en: We produce a hearty soup every winter.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们每年冬天都会制作一道丰盛的汤。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to produce a hearty soup

vocab_pack.definition_en: to communicate using video telephony
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中makes为一般现在时，主语The owner为第三人称单数，用makes。
vocab_pack.example_en: I make video calls to my family every week.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我每周和家人打视频电话。
vocab_pack.from_passage: owner even makes video calls to her grandparents

vocab_pack.definition_en: using something as a foundation or starting point
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中based on为过去分词短语，修饰adapts的方式；based on引出依据。
vocab_pack.example_en: The movie is based on a true story.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部电影基于真实故事。
vocab_pack.from_passage: adapts the soup based on customer feedback

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be appropriate for the tastes of a local population
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中suit为不定式（与to suit），表示目的；local preferences为宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The restaurant changes its menu to suit local preferences.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家餐厅改变菜单以适应当地喜好。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to suit local preferences

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue changing and developing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中keeps为一般现在时，主语it（version）为单数，用keeps；evolving为动名词作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Language keeps evolving over time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 语言随时间不断演变。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it keeps evolving

vocab_pack.definition_en: to reduce or overcome gaps between cultures
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中bridges为一般现在时，主语sharing food为动名词短语（单数），故用bridges。
vocab_pack.example_en: Music can bridge cultural differences between people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 音乐可以弥合人与人之间的文化差异。
vocab_pack.from_passage: sharing food bridges cultural differences

vocab_pack.definition_en: to narrate an account of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中telling为现在分词，与with each bowl构成独立主格结构，表示伴随。
vocab_pack.example_en: Each painting tells a story of the artist's life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每幅画都讲述了艺术家的生活故事。
vocab_pack.from_passage: with each bowl telling a story of tradition, creativity, and the delight of flavor discovery

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of discovering new tastes
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中flavor discovery为名词短语，作the delight of的宾语，表示一种探索的乐趣。
vocab_pack.example_en: Traveling is a journey of flavor discovery.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 旅行是一场风味发现的旅程。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the delight of flavor discovery

vocab_pack.definition_en: a famous person or thing known worldwide
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 全球明星；世界闻名的食物
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中global star为介词to的宾语，与from street food构成对比结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: The dish has become a global star.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这道菜已成为全球明星。
vocab_pack.from_passage: From street food to a global star
